title: In mid-March 1446 the explorer ʿAbd al-Jalīl al-Qubbāṣī reaches a cape where Africa appears to come to an end. The merchants of al-Andalus research the Kongo, and the attempted settlement of Fernando Po is withdrawn

data.explorer: ʿAbd al-Jalīl of the house of al-Qubbāṣa (Alcobaça), character 16838110, explorer from 30 October 1445 (autosave of 1 February 1447)
data.why withdrawn: low migration and no direct need: the route south runs by Mali; may be resumed when the sea road needs it (Trent, 12 November 2026)
